ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity black to 35% high-intensity white. High-contrast boundaries are sharp between the black margins and central white pigmentation regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white patches are located in the medial-lateral quadrant of each lobe. These patches are heavily fragmented by internal low-intensity linear streaks. The peduncle area and all outer margins are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation with a narrow vertex angle, roughly 40 degrees, and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge, with irregular peak-and-valley patterns most prominent on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge with a pronounced upward taper toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast yellowish-white clusters of raised pixel groups visible at the extreme distal tips (points) of both lobes, representing barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive, unaligned black linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation zones on both lobes, appearing as high-contrast diagonal and vertical strikes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable raggedness and micro-tears along the trailing edge contour; distinct barnacle colonization clusters on the left and right fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific thick, vertical black 'V' shaped mark within the lower boundary of the white patch on the left lobe.
